# ZudoJS

> ZudoJS (Zudo) is a modular TypeScript framework for Node.js. It is split into 39 independent @zudojs/* packages (dependency injection, configuration, HTTP, events, messaging, CQRS, auth, permissions, database, cache, queues, observability and more) that share one set of contracts, so an application installs only the packages it uses.

Facts an agent needs before writing ZudoJS code:

- Runtime: Node.js 24 or newer. Packages are ESM only, so the consuming project needs `"type": "module"`. Written for TypeScript in strict mode.
- Install only the packages you use: `npm install @zudojs/core @zudojs/http`. Each package page ends with a complete export index generated from the package source.
- Scaffold a new project: `npx zudojs-cli create my-app`.
- Every docs page has a Markdown copy at the same URL with `.md` appended (for example [packages-http.md](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-http.md)). [llms-full.txt](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/llms-full.txt) is all of them in one file.
- Source code: https://github.com/oyinlola-tech/zudo. npm org: https://www.npmjs.com/org/zudojs.
- Logo and brand assets: [/brand](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/brand.md) is the page; [brand.json](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/assets/brand/brand.json) is the same kit as data (every file's URL, format, pixel size and intended background, plus the palette, the usage rules and the licence). The mark is [zudo-mark.svg](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/assets/zudo-mark.svg); use the `-dark` files on dark backgrounds.

## ZudoJS Academy (courses and lessons, in order)

- [ZudoJS Academy — learn programming, JavaScript, TypeScript and backend engineering](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/index.md): A free academy that takes you from programming logic to JavaScript, algorithms, TypeScript, backend engineering, security and architecture, then to production ZudoJS applications. Every example runs in your browser or on your computer, with the real output shown.
- [Programming thinking — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/programming-thinking.md): Think like a programmer before you write serious code: break problems down, design algorithms in pseudocode and flowcharts, reason with logic and a little mathematics, and solve problems step by step.
- [Welcome to ZudoJS Academy — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/welcome.md): What ZudoJS Academy is, who it is for, its six tracks and 19 levels, the projects you build, how the pages work, and where you should start.
- [Your developer environment — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dev-environment.md): Meet the tools a developer uses every day, the terminal, a code editor and the browser's devtools, and learn to move around your files by typing commands.
- [How programs run — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/how-programs-run.md): What happens between the code you type and the result on screen: compilers, interpreters, engines and runtimes, and syntax, runtime and logic errors.
- [How the web works — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/how-the-web-works.md): Follow a request from your browser to a server and back, and learn what clients, servers, IP addresses, DNS, ports, HTTP, HTTPS, APIs and databases are.
- [What programming is — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/think-programming.md): Learn what programs, instructions and algorithms are, see every program as input, processing and output, and solve a real problem with the problem-solving loop.
- [Breaking problems down — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/think-decomposition.md): Split a problem as big as "build a bank" into pieces small enough to solve, order them by dependency, and build a money transfer from small, tested steps.
- [Algorithms — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/think-algorithms.md): Learn what makes a method an algorithm, the three shapes every algorithm is built from, and everyday searching, counting, filtering and sorting.
- [Pseudocode and flowcharts — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/think-pseudocode.md): Write an algorithm as pseudocode and as a flowchart, trace it by hand, find its missing paths, and translate it line by line into working JavaScript.
- [Reasoning about programs — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/think-reasoning.md): Ask what you know, what you assume and what must stay true, build edge-case tables, and use invariants to show a program works for every input, not just a few.
- [Boolean logic — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/logic-boolean.md): Reduce program decisions to true and false, combine them with AND, OR, NOT and XOR, and let a loop build truth tables that check every case for you.
- [Conditional reasoning — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/logic-conditions.md): Turn business rules into exact conditions, invert and simplify them safely with De Morgan's laws, and write guard clauses that explain every refusal.
- [Sets — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/logic-sets.md): Reason about groups with sets: remove duplicates, test membership, and combine permissions, tags and mailing lists with union, intersection and difference.
- [Mathematical reasoning — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/logic-math.md): Use expressions, equations, ratios and percentages to compute discounts, VAT and interest, and keep money exact by counting in kobo, not decimals.
- [Sequences — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/logic-sequences.md): Spot the pattern in a list of numbers, compute arithmetic and geometric sequences with loops and formulas, and see why compound interest surprises people.
- [Counting — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/logic-counting.md): Count with loops and frequency tables, count possibilities with permutations and combinations, and see why trying every option soon becomes impossible.
- [Problem workshop: beginner — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/solve-beginner.md): Solve ten everyday problems, from even or odd to a tax calculator, by reasoning about inputs, outputs and edge cases first, then coding and testing each one.
- [Problem workshop: intermediate — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/solve-intermediate.md): Solve eight problems on lists of real data, from duplicate payments to stock levels, reasoning about edge cases and work first, then coding and testing.
- [Why doesn't this work? — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/solve-broken.md): Diagnose broken algorithms that run without errors but give wrong answers, using trace tables, predictions and boundary tests, then fix each root cause.
- [JavaScript fundamentals — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/javascript.md): The JavaScript language from your first line: values and types, scope, operators, decisions and loops, functions, arrays and objects, classes, errors, modules and your first asynchronous code.
- [Meet JavaScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-intro.md): Learn where JavaScript comes from, who decides how it changes, how to tell which features you can use, and the syntax rules every line of code follows.
- [Set up your computer — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/setup.md): Install Node.js, try JavaScript in the Node.js REPL, write and run your first program, and turn its folder into a project.
- [Values, variables and types — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-values.md): Store values in variables with const and let, meet the seven primitive types, and learn how JavaScript handles text, numbers, true and false, and "no value".
- [Types in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-types-deep.md): Map every JavaScript type, see why objects are shared while primitives are copied, and learn how equality and type coercion decide what comparisons return.
- [Operators — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-operators.md): Calculate, compare and combine values with every JavaScript operator, give missing values safe defaults with ?? and ?., and avoid the precedence traps.
- [Making decisions — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-conditions.md): Let your program choose what to do with if, else if and else, the ternary operator and switch, and keep decisions readable with guard clauses.
- [Loops — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-loops.md): Repeat work with for, while, do...while, for...of and for...in, control a loop with break and continue, and build a number guessing game.
- [Functions — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-functions.md): Package logic into reusable functions, pass values in and get results out, pass functions to other functions, and meet scope, closures and recursion.
- [Arrays — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-arrays.md): Keep ordered lists in arrays, add, remove and search items, transform them with map, filter, reduce and sort, and build a small student management system.
- [Objects and JSON — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-data.md): Group related values into objects, read and change their properties, copy and take them apart safely, and turn them into JSON, the text format every API speaks.
- [Objects in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-objects-deep.md): Lock an object's shape, validate writes with setters, hide fields, and copy and compare objects safely, by building a bank account that cannot be broken.
- [Modern JavaScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-modern.md): Take a piece of old-style JavaScript and rewrite it step by step with the modern syntax a backend uses every day, fixing real bugs on the way.
- [Scope and how code runs — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-scope.md): Learn where a name can be used, why some names exist before their line runs, and how the call stack and the heap work, so you can read a stack trace.
- [Closures in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-closures.md): See how closures really work through lexical environments, then use them for private state, function factories, memoization and cleanup, without leaking memory.
- [Recursion — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-recursion.md): Walk folders, comment threads and org charts of any depth with functions that call themselves, then make them safe against deep and circular data.
- [this, prototypes and classes — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-classes.md): See what this means in a method and why it gets lost, how objects share methods through prototypes, and write classes with private fields and inheritance.
- [Handling errors — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-errors.md): Tell syntax, runtime and logic errors apart, throw and catch errors, write your own error classes, and turn every error into a safe answer from an API.
- [Asynchronous JavaScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-async.md): See why a backend waits without blocking, use callbacks, promises and async/await, handle errors in async code, and run work in sequence or in parallel.
- [Modules — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-modules.md): Split a program into files with ES modules, understand the older CommonJS require, choose between named and default exports, and avoid circular dependencies.
- [Algorithms and data structures — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/algorithms.md): Measure code with Big O, build the classic data structures in JavaScript, learn the algorithms every engineer uses, and solve problems with named patterns instead of guesswork.
- [Big O and complexity — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-complexity.md): Measure how code grows with its input: count steps, state time and space complexity in Big O, Ω and Θ, spot hidden loops and see why push is cheap.
- [Arrays and strings under the hood — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-arrays-strings.md): Learn what array and string operations really cost, from indexing to shift and string building, then solve reverse, palindrome, anagram and rotate with tests.
- [Hash maps and sets — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-hash-maps.md): Build a hash table from scratch with hashing, buckets, collisions and resizing, then use Map and Set for lookups, counting, dedupe and two-sum.
- [Stacks and queues — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-stacks-queues.md): Build stacks, queues, a ring buffer and a deque in JavaScript, then use them for undo and redo, bracket checking and a retrying job queue.
- [Linked lists and the LRU cache — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-linked-lists.md): Build singly and doubly linked lists in JavaScript, reverse them, detect cycles, and use one to build an O(1) LRU cache for product lookups.
- [Trees and binary search trees — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-trees.md): Turn flat category rows into a tree, walk it four ways, then build, test and balance a binary search tree of orders, with the cost of every operation.
- [Heaps and priority queues — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-heaps.md): Build a binary heap on a plain array, use it as a priority job queue, then sort with it, find the top-k products and merge sorted order lists.
- [Graphs and topological sort — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-graphs.md): Model packages, roads between cities and followers as graphs, store them as adjacency lists, and compute a safe install order with topological sort.
- [Tries and autocomplete — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-tries.md): Build a prefix tree for product search: autocomplete as the user types, count matches per prefix, delete safely, and weigh the memory it costs.
- [Linear and binary search — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-searching.md): Find an order among a million by scanning and by halving, write binary search three ways, catch its classic bugs, and use lower and upper bounds for ranges.
- [Sorting algorithms — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-sorting.md): Build bubble, selection, insertion, merge and quick sort, count their comparisons, then sort real orders by several keys with a stable, tested sort.
- [Divide and conquer — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-divide-conquer.md): Split problems into halves and combine: find delivery-time percentiles with quickselect, compute powers fast, and predict cost with recursion trees.
- [Graph search — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-graph-search.md): Route parcels with breadth-first search, solve a warehouse maze, find cut-off areas and circular transfers with depth-first search, and meet Dijkstra.
- [Greedy algorithms — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-greedy.md): Give change in naira, book meeting rooms and load a van by taking the best-looking choice, then prove when that works and catch it failing with tests.
- [Backtracking — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-backtracking.md): Find every valid coupon combination, gift bundle and delivery route by choosing, exploring and undoing, then prune dead branches to solve N-queens and sudoku.
- [Dynamic programming — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dsa-dynamic-programming.md): Turn exponential searches into fast tables: pack a delivery van, make change in naira, and diff two versions of a text, with memoization and tabulation.
- [The frequency counter pattern — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/pattern-frequency.md): Replace nested loops with one counting pass: check anagram usernames, reconcile lists, find the first unmatched entry and the majority, in O(n).
- [The two pointers pattern — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/pattern-two-pointers.md): Walk sorted data from both ends or at two speeds: pair refunds, dedupe order ids in place, size a tank, and find loops and midpoints with O(1) extra space.
- [Sliding window and prefix sums — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/pattern-sliding-window.md): Find the best 7 days of revenue, the longest on-time streak and any range total without re-adding numbers, using sliding windows and prefix sums.
- [Binary search on the answer — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/pattern-binary-search.md): Use binary search beyond sorted arrays: find the smallest truck capacity, the first failing build and items in rotated lists by halving a range of answers.
- [Pattern practice — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/pattern-practice.md): Solve eleven unlabelled problems by first naming the pattern and why, then coding, testing and analysing, plus two interview walkthroughs.
- [Advanced JavaScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/javascript-advanced.md): How JavaScript really works: this and prototypes, the built-in objects, iterators, generators and symbols, functional techniques, the event loop and asynchronous code in depth, memory, error design and module systems.
- [this in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-this.md): Predict this in every kind of call, fix a lost this with call, apply, bind and arrow functions, and write your own bind and bindAll helpers.
- [Prototypes in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-prototypes.md): Follow the prototype chain step by step, rewrite new, instanceof and extends yourself, see what a class becomes, and block prototype pollution.
- [Inheritance and composition — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-composition.md): See why subclasses break when their parent changes, then build behaviour from wrappers, delegation, mixins and functions, and use private fields well.
- [Strings in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-strings.md): Measure, cut, normalise, search, sort and format product names with accents and emoji, using code points, graphemes, Intl.Segmenter and Intl.Collator.
- [Numbers in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-numbers.md): Learn how IEEE-754 doubles store numbers, where precision ends, how to round, parse and format naira amounts exactly, and when to reach for BigInt.
- [Collections in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-collections.md): Choose between Map, Set, WeakMap, WeakSet and WeakRef by how they compare keys, keep order and hold memory; build a bounded cache and object-keyed memos.
- [Dates and time zones — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-dates.md): Understand what a Date really stores, parse and format instants safely across Africa/Lagos and UTC, do calendar arithmetic, and store dates correctly in APIs.
- [Regular expressions — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-regexp.md): Validate phone numbers and order codes, parse log lines with named groups, rewrite text with replacers, and avoid regex patterns that freeze a server.
- [Iterables and iterators — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-iterators.md): Learn the protocol behind for...of, spread and destructuring, then write your own iterables: a number range and an API paginator that fetches pages lazily.
- [Generators — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-generators.md): Write iterators as ordinary loops with function* and yield, then stream order lines lazily from a paged API into a CSV export, with cleanup that always runs.
- [Symbols — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-symbols.md): Use symbols as keys that never clash, plug your objects into the language with well-known symbols, and build a Money type that refuses to add naira to dollars.
- [Functional JavaScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-functional.md): Turn a tangled checkout function into a pipeline of small pure steps, with immutable updates, composition, currying and partial application, and test each step.
- [Promises in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-promises.md): See exactly what a promise guarantees, how chains pass values and errors along, how thenables work, and how to turn a callback SDK into promises safely.
- [Combining promises — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-promise-combinators.md): Run independent work in parallel with Promise.all, allSettled, race and any, put a time limit on a slow provider, and choose sequential, parallel or batched.
- [The event loop — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-event-loop.md): Build an exact model of the call stack, task queue and microtask queue, solve ordering puzzles with it, and keep long jobs from starving timers and requests.
- [Concurrency and cancellation — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-concurrency.md): Limit how many jobs run at once with a pool, cancel unneeded work with AbortController, and find and fix the race conditions of concurrent async code.
- [How JavaScript runs — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-execution.md): Follow your code through the engine, from text to tokens, syntax tree, bytecode and machine code, and read sync and async stack traces with confidence.
- [Memory and garbage collection — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-memory.md): Learn how the garbage collector decides what to free, cause and fix the classic leaks, and measure memory with process.memoryUsage and heap snapshots.
- [Designing error handling — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-error-design.md): Decide which layer handles each error, chain causes, collect failures with AggregateError, and build a payment flow that never loses an error.
- [Module systems in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-module-systems.md): See how ES modules and CommonJS load and interoperate in Node.js 24, resolve packages via exports, load plugins with import(), and untangle circular imports.
- [JavaScript in the browser and on the server — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/javascript-platforms.md): Use JavaScript where it runs: the DOM, events and browser APIs, networking from the browser, Node.js and its core modules, npm and the tooling around it, professional debugging, and Git.
- [What Node.js is — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/node-runtime.md): Learn what Node.js adds to JavaScript, where its event loop fits, and how a program uses arguments, exit codes and environment variables to talk to the system.
- [Files, paths and your computer — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/node-apis.md): Build safe file paths, read and write files, handle missing files, make random ids and hashes, and announce events, then save a task list to a JSON file.
- [Streams and buffers — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/node-streams.md): Learn what bytes and buffers are, then process files far bigger than memory piece by piece with readable, writable and transform streams, pipeline and readline.
- [Events, processes and workers — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/node-events-processes.md): Coordinate a Node.js program with EventEmitter, run other programs as child processes, move heavy work to worker threads, and shut down cleanly on SIGTERM.
- [Cryptography with node:crypto — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/node-crypto.md): Use node:crypto correctly: unguessable tokens, hashes and HMAC webhook signatures, timing-safe comparison, scrypt password hashing and AES-256-GCM encryption.
- [npm and packages — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/npm-packages.md): Install, update and remove packages with npm, read package.json and the lockfile, use version ranges and scripts, and keep the packages you install safe.
- [The npm ecosystem in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/npm-ecosystem.md): Go beyond npm install: exact semver rules, the dependency tree and lockfile, peer dependencies, lifecycle scripts, publishing and supply-chain defence.
- [An HTTP server with no framework — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/node-http.md): Build a web server with only node:http: read the method, path, query, headers and body of a request, route by hand and answer JSON with the right status.
- [Build a plain Node.js Task API — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/node-task-api.md): Build a complete Task API with no framework: modules, middleware, central error handling, an API key and checked configuration, then see what hurts as it grows.
- [The DOM — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/browser-dom.md): Read and change a web page from JavaScript: find, create, update and remove elements safely, avoid innerHTML XSS, and build a task list UI rendered from data.
- [Events — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/browser-events.md): Make a shopping cart respond to clicks, typing and forms with listeners, bubbling and capturing, preventDefault, delegation, custom events and a debounce.
- [Browser APIs — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/browser-apis.md): Use the browser's tools with their failure modes: fetch, localStorage, URL and URLSearchParams, the History API, timers, requestAnimationFrame and Web Workers.
- [Networking from JavaScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/browser-networking.md): Connect a page to your Node.js Task API: the request lifecycle, JSON, the same-origin policy, CORS and preflight, HttpOnly session cookies and cancellation.
- [Real-time and background work — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/browser-realtime.md): Push live updates to a page with Server-Sent Events and WebSockets, each with a Node.js server, and move heavy page work to Web Workers with messages.
- [Git and GitHub — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/git.md): Track every change with Git, work on branches and resolve a real merge conflict, keep node_modules and secrets out of the repository, and share work on GitHub.
- [Professional Git — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/git-collaboration.md): Work like a professional team: issues, pull requests, code review, merge versus rebase, rebase conflicts, tags, releases, changelogs and open source.
- [JavaScript tooling — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/js-tooling.md): Learn why each JavaScript tool exists, run Prettier and ESLint for real, see what a bundler does, map a minified stack trace back to source and validate config.
- [The debugging method — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/debug-method.md): Find bugs with a repeatable method: observe, reproduce, isolate, hypothesize, test, fix and verify. Read stack traces, log well and shrink a minimal repro.
- [Debugging tools — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/debug-tools.md): Pause a program at breakpoints, step through it and watch values in Node.js and the browser, read network traffic, and map compiled code back with source maps.
- [Debugging practice — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/debug-practice.md): Find a regression with binary search and git bisect run, dig to root causes with the five whys, and work five complete bug hunts from report to regression test.
- [TypeScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/typescript.md): Add a type system to JavaScript: what TypeScript is and is not, everyday types and inference, unions and narrowing, interfaces, generics, classes, modules, tsconfig, and where types stop and runtime validation begins.
- [Why TypeScript exists — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-setup.md): See a bug that JavaScript runs without complaint, install TypeScript, write a tsconfig.json, and learn the three ways to run TypeScript on Node.js 24.
- [What the TypeScript compiler does — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-compiler.md): Follow a TypeScript file through tsc: checking, type erasure, transpiling to older JavaScript, emitted files, watch mode and Node's type stripping.
- [Basic types — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-types.md): Type strings, numbers, booleans, arrays, tuples and objects, handle null and undefined under strict mode, and meet any, unknown, void and never.
- [Type inference in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-inference.md): See how TypeScript works out the types you never wrote (literals, widening, contextual typing, inferred returns) and decide where an annotation pays off.
- [Typing functions — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-functions.md): Type parameters and return values, use optional, default and rest parameters, write function types for callbacks, type async functions, and meet overloads.
- [Interfaces, unions and literal types — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-objects.md): Name object shapes, mark properties optional or readonly, extend and combine them, and model data with several forms using unions and literal types.
- [Union types in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-unions.md): Model real states with discriminated unions, return typed results instead of throwing, combine shapes with intersections, and avoid common union mistakes.
- [Type aliases and interfaces — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-aliases-interfaces.md): Name your domain types once, extend them safely, use declaration merging and recursive types, and learn the real differences between type and interface.
- [Special types: any, unknown, never and friends — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-special-types.md): Learn what any, unknown, never, void, object, {} and Object really mean, watch one any spread, and use unknown at your program's boundaries.
- [Narrowing — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-narrowing.md): Turn wide unions and unknown into precise types with typeof, equality, in, instanceof, discriminants, type guards and assertion functions, and avoid the traps.
- [Type assertions — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-assertions.md): Learn what as, angle brackets, as unknown as and the non-null ! really do, why none of them check or convert anything, and which safer tool to use instead.
- [Enums and their alternatives — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-enums.md): Write numeric, string and const enums, read the JavaScript tsc emits for each, avoid their pitfalls, and replace them with unions and as const objects.
- [Tuples — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-tuples.md): Type fixed-shape arrays with tuples: optional, rest and named elements, readonly tuples and tuple inference, and return tuples the way useState does.
- [Generics — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-generics.md): Write functions, interfaces and classes that work for many types without losing safety, constrain them with extends and keyof, and give them defaults.
- [Designing generic APIs — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-generic-design.md): Design generic APIs that are easy to call and hard to misuse, and build Repository, Result, Page, ApiResponse, Cache and a typed event emitter.
- [Advanced and utility types — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-advanced.md): Derive types from one source of truth with keyof, typeof, indexed access and the utility types, and get a first look at mapped, conditional and template types.
- [Classes in TypeScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-classes.md): Type class properties, use access modifiers and #private, write abstract classes and classes that implement interfaces, and inject dependencies.
- [Modules in TypeScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-modules.md): Split a project into files, import types with import type, write .js in import paths, and see how NodeNext, "type": "module" and "exports" fit together.
- [tsconfig in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-tsconfig.md): Learn what every important tsconfig.json option changes, from target, lib and module to each strict flag and verbatimModuleSyntax, with a real tsc run for each.
- [TypeScript and JavaScript together — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-runtime.md): See why types cannot check data that arrives while the program runs, and close the gap by hand with guards, assertion functions and a validator.
- [Runtime validation — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-validation.md): See why an annotation on parsed JSON checks nothing, then validate data at runtime with a schema you build, Zod, Valibot and JSON Schema, and infer types.
- [Typed error handling — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-errors.md): Catch errors as unknown, write error classes with a name, a cause and a literal code, return typed results, and handle async failures in a payments service.
- [Async TypeScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-async.md): Type async functions precisely, keep Promise.all tuples intact, narrow allSettled results, use Awaited, and page through an API with async generators.
- [Advanced TypeScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/typescript-advanced.md): The type system in depth: type operators, utility, mapped, conditional and template literal types, inference, variance and branded types, then type-safe events, CQRS and dependency injection, decorators, declaration files, packages, monorepos, type-level tests and compiler performance.
- [Type operators — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-type-operators.md): Derive types from values and from other types with keyof, typeof and indexed access, learn their edge cases, and build an order workflow from one table.
- [Utility types — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-utility-types.md): Use and rebuild TypeScript's utility types, from Partial, Pick and Omit to Exclude, ReturnType, Awaited and ThisType, and learn where each one bites.
- [Mapped types — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-mapped-types.md): Loop over keys at the type level: change modifiers, remap keys with as, filter and recurse into nested objects, then build a type-safe config system.
- [Conditional types — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-conditional-types.md): Write types that choose a result from their input with extends, infer and recursion, control distribution over unions, and build a retrying payments client.
- [Template literal types — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-template-literals.md): Build and take apart string types with template literal types, Uppercase and infer, then type routes, permissions and a compile-time safe event name system.
- [Advanced inference — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-inference-deep.md): Learn how TypeScript infers type arguments, contextual types and return types, use const type parameters, and choose satisfies, as or as const.
- [Advanced functions — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-advanced-functions.md): Type overloads, call and construct signatures, this parameters, callable objects and variadic tuples, then build a type-safe command router.
- [Object-oriented TypeScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-oop.md): Use encapsulation, abstraction, inheritance, polymorphism, composition and dependency inversion, then compare OOP and functional designs honestly.
- [Functional TypeScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-functional.md): Make signatures tell the truth with readonly data, typed composition, Option, Result and algebraic data types, then build a typed pricing and checkout core.
- [The type system in depth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-type-system.md): Learn when one type fits another: structural typing, excess property checks, variance with in and out, computed types, and when a clever type costs too much.
- [Branded types — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-branded-types.md): Stop swapped ids and naira-for-kobo bugs at compile time with branded types, validating smart constructors, money units and the ids in @zudojs/constants.
- [Type-safe domain modelling — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-domain-modeling.md): Model a shop's users, roles, products, orders, payments, events and ledger so illegal states cannot be written: no double payment, no refund before capture.
- [A type-safe event system — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-typed-events.md): Build an event bus where emit("order.placed", payload) only accepts the right payload: typed listeners, unsubscribe, wildcards and their limits.
- [Type-safe CQRS — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-typed-cqrs.md): Build a command bus and a query bus whose requests, handlers and results are checked from one spec, so a missing handler or a wrong result will not compile.
- [A type-safe dependency injection container — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-typed-di.md): Build a DI container with typed tokens, factories and singleton, scoped and transient lifetimes, and learn exactly which wiring errors types cannot catch.
- [Decorators — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-decorators.md): Write TC39 standard decorators for classes, methods, fields and accessors, see the JavaScript tsc emits, and compare them with experimentalDecorators.
- [Declaration files — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-declarations.md): Type an untyped JavaScript naira formatter with a .d.ts file, declare modules and globals, augment interfaces, install @types and generate declarations.

- [TypeScript monorepos — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-monorepos.md): Split a shop backend into core, logger, database, auth and http packages, link with workspaces, build with project references, enforce dependency direction.
- [Testing TypeScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-testing.md): Test TypeScript code with Vitest, including generics, error paths and typed mocks, then test types themselves with expectTypeOf and vitest --typecheck.
- [Debugging TypeScript — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-debugging.md): Read long type errors from the bottom up, make the compiler show inferred types, fix generic inference and module resolution, and tell type from runtime bugs.
- [Compiler performance — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/ts-performance.md): Measure what tsc spends its work on with --extendedDiagnostics, then keep a large project fast with skipLibCheck, incremental builds and bounded types.

- [Transactions — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-transactions.md): Coordinate transactions across functions with @zudojs/transactions: propagation via AsyncLocalStorage, savepoints, after-commit hooks, retries and timeouts.
- ["Project: a file upload system" — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-file-uploads.md): Build task attachments with @zudojs/http and @zudojs/storage: size limits, sniffed content types, safe keys, metadata, fenced locks and failure recovery.
- [Cryptography with @zudojs/crypto — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-crypto.md): Use @zudojs/crypto for random ids, tokens, hashes, HMAC, password hashing, AES-GCM encryption with key ids and constant-time checks, building reset tokens.
- [Authentication — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-auth.md): Let users log in to the Task API: hash passwords, issue JWTs, keep sessions with real logout, protect routes, and stop guessing with lockouts and limits.
- [Sign in with OAuth — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-oauth.md): Add Sign in with Google to the Task API with @zudojs/auth-oauth: the OAuth 2 code flow, state and PKCE, provider presets, tested offline.
- [Permissions — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-permissions.md): Decide what each logged-in user may do with @zudojs/permissions: roles, wildcards, hierarchy, owner and deny rules, policies, and stopping privilege escalation.
- [Security for every public API — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-security.md): Protect the Task API from the open internet with @zudojs/security: rate limiting, CORS, CSRF, security headers, secure cookies, body limits, SSRF checks.
- [Caching — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-cache.md): Keep copies of slow results so the Task API answers fast: keys, TTL, namespaces, tags, invalidation, stampede protection, locks and metrics.
- [Type-safe application design — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-typed-design.md): Design a billing module for the Task API where ids, money, states, DTOs, commands, queries, events, errors, config and DI are all checked by TypeScript.
- [ZudoJS advanced systems — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-advanced.md): Events, messages and CQRS, queues and schedulers, serialization, RPC, API operations and OpenAPI, then testing, logging, observability and documentation, and platform features: feature flags, tenancy, plugins and adapters.
- [Events — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-events.md): Decouple Task API features with events: handlers, wildcards, priorities, sequential and parallel dispatch, middleware and handler errors with @zudojs/events.
- [Messaging — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-messaging.md): Ask another part of the Task API to do something and get an answer back with @zudojs/messaging: messages, middleware, correlation ids, timeouts, cancellation.
- [Commands and queries (CQRS) — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-cqrs.md): Split the Task API into commands that change data and queries that only read it: buses, handlers, middleware, execution context, results with @zudojs/cqrs.
- [Background jobs — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-queue.md): Move slow, unreliable work out of the request into a job queue: jobs, processors, workers, concurrency, retries with backoff, dead letters with @zudojs/queue.
- [Scheduled tasks — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-scheduler.md): Run work on the clock, not a request: intervals, cron expressions, time zones, retries, overlapping runs and running on one instance with @zudojs/scheduler.
- [Serialization — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-serialization.md): Turn values into text and back without losing what they were: Dates, BigInts, Maps, Sets, bytes, custom types and versioned payloads with @zudojs/serialization.
- [Calling services with RPC — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-rpc.md): Call a function in another service as if it were local: procedures, clients, transports, validation, errors, identity, timeouts and retries with @zudojs/rpc.
- [One operation, many transports — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-api.md): Write business logic once as an operation with @zudojs/api, then run it from HTTP, RPC and a queue with the same validation, errors and timeouts.
- [OpenAPI documents — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-openapi.md): Describe the Task API in an OpenAPI document with @zudojs/openapi: schemas as components, OpenAPI 3.0 or 3.1, validation, JSON or YAML, a docs page.
- [Testing a ZudoJS app — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-testing.md): Test the Task API with Vitest and @zudojs/testing: a test clock, mocks and recording buses, a test container, ordered cleanup, and real HTTP integration tests.
- [Testing a ZudoJS application layer by layer — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-testing-apps.md): Test the Task API one layer at a time with Vitest: services, PGlite repositories, auth sessions, events and queues, CQRS buses, HTTP routes and a full workflow.
- [Structured logging — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-logging.md): Replace console.log with structured entries a program can search: levels, child loggers, request ids, redaction and JSON logs with @zudojs/logger.
- [Observability — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-observability.md): See inside a running Task API: metrics count what happens, traces show where time goes, and logs share one trace id with @zudojs/observability.
- [Documentation as data with @zudojs/docs — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-docs.md): Turn the Task API's Markdown docs into checked data with @zudojs/docs: documents, frontmatter, a registry, link and navigation checks, and generated output.
- [Feature flags — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-feature-flags.md): Turn features on and off without deploying: rules, evaluation context, percentage rollouts, A/B variants and kill switches with @zudojs/feature-flags.
- [Multi-tenancy — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-tenancy.md): Serve many companies from one Task API without mixing their data: tenant ids, resolvers, trust levels and tenant-scoped queries with @zudojs/tenancy.
- [Plugins — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-plugins.md): Extend the Task API through a fixed interface without editing it: plugin lifecycle, dependencies, scoped context, rollback and diagnostics with @zudojs/plugins.
- [Adapters with @zudojs/adapters — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-adapters.md): Put a payment provider behind an adapter with @zudojs/adapters, then swap a fake for a real HTTP provider without touching checkout.
- [ZudoJS architecture — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-architecture.md): Build the same application as a monolith, a modular monolith and microservices, then build event-driven and full CQRS systems, and compare the trade-offs honestly.
- [A well-structured monolith — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-monolith.md): Build ShopFlow as one ZudoJS application with auth, users, products, orders, payments and notifications, one database and one deploy, and see where it strains.
- [From monolith to modular monolith — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-modular-monolith.md): Split a growing monolith into modules with clear boundaries: each owns its data, exposes a small public API, and talks to others via events and commands.
- [Microservices — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-microservices.md): Why teams split into microservices, why not to start there, and how services discover, call each other, stay consistent, survive failures and stay observable.
- [Event-driven systems — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-event-driven.md): Build an OrderCreated flow whose email, audit and analytics handlers survive retries, duplicates, crashes, dead letters and a v1 to v2 payload change.
- [A CQRS system — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-cqrs-system.md): Build ShopFlow orders as a full CQRS system: transactional commands with an outbox, a projected read model, typed buses, an HTTP API and one trace end to end.
- [Distributed systems — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/distributed-systems.md): What changes when your system spans processes and machines: partial failure, consistency, contracts between services, retries and circuit breakers, and transactions that cross service boundaries.
- [Distributed systems fundamentals — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dist-fundamentals.md): Simulate an unreliable network with a seeded random generator, then reason about partial failure, clocks, consistency, CAP and service discovery.
- [Contracts between services — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dist-contracts.md): Version service contracts so independent deploys stay compatible: evolve schemas safely and catch breaks with consumer-driven contract tests.
- [Failure engineering — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dist-reliability.md): Break ShopFlow with a seeded fault injector, then keep it serving with timeouts, jittered retries, a circuit breaker, bulkheads, fallbacks and readiness checks.
- [Transactions across services — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/dist-transactions.md): Keep an order, payment, stock and shipment consistent across services with sagas, compensations, a transactional outbox and idempotent consumers.
- [Production engineering — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/production.md): Take a ZudoJS application to production: the production checklist, a security review, performance diagnosis, deployment with Docker, and a CI/CD pipeline.
- [Production engineering — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/production-engineering.md): A checklist for taking a ZudoJS app to production: config, secrets, logs, metrics, health checks, shutdown, rate limits, caching and database performance.
- [A production security review — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-production-security.md): Review the Task API before launch: seventeen checks from authentication to log leakage, each with the safe ZudoJS setup and a test that proves it holds.
- [Diagnosing performance — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-performance.md): Find out why the Task API is slow before changing anything: load tests, event-loop lag, CPU profiles, query plans, pools, caches, workers and memory.
- [Deploying a ZudoJS app — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/deployment.md): Take the Task API to a server: build it, run with systemd or Docker Compose, add Postgres, Redis and Caddy for HTTPS, migrate safely, back up the database.
- [CI/CD with GitHub Actions — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-ci-cd.md): Build a pipeline for the Task API that type-checks, lints, tests, audits, builds and deploys every change, with migrations and automatic rollback.
- [Framework engineering — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/framework-engineering.md): Stop being only a consumer: read ZudoJS's source, create your own ZudoJS package, and build a complete plugin.
- [Reading ZudoJS internals — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-internals.md): Open the published @zudojs packages in node_modules, map their dependency graph, and trace how routing, scopes, wildcards and caching really work.
- [Creating a ZudoJS package — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-create-package.md): Build @mycompany/zudo-payments as a real npm package: public/internal API, ZudoJS errors, a provider adapter, Vitest tests, checked docs and changesets.
- [Building a complete ZudoJS plugin — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-create-plugin.md): Build a production-grade receipts plugin with @zudojs/plugins: metadata, dependencies, lifecycle, scoped context, events, diagnostics and rollback.
- [Real-world projects and capstone — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/capstone.md): Real applications built end to end with ZudoJS: a REST API, an authentication platform, a payment system, a multi-tenant SaaS, a background processing system and a microservice platform, then the capstones.
- [Use case: a REST API for users, products and orders — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/usecase-rest-api.md): Build Oja Market's public API from a product brief: resources and status codes, schemas, JWT access, keyset pagination, OpenAPI and contract tests.
- [Use case: an authentication platform — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/usecase-auth-platform.md): Build Sabi School's account platform: registration, sessions, JWT rotation, password reset links, roles and sign-in with an OAuth provider, all tested.
- [Use case: a payment system — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/usecase-payments.md): Build Oja Market's card payments: idempotent requests, a gateway adapter with timeouts and retries, an outbox, events, a notification queue, and failure tests.
- [Use case: a multi-tenant SaaS — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/usecase-saas.md): Build InvoiceHub, where many businesses share one app and one database, and prove with tests that one organization can never read another's data.
- [Use case: background processing — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/usecase-background-jobs.md): Move invoice e-mails out of the request: a durable job ledger, a queue with retries, scheduled reminders, correlation ids and recovery from crashed workers.
- [Use case: a microservice platform — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/usecase-microservices.md): Split Oja Market into six services that call each other over RPC, announce events through an outbox, retry through queues, and share one trace per request.
- [A whole project through the CLI — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/zudo-cli-project.md): Build a hall-booking API from zudojs create to a Docker image, generating each layer with the CLI and fixing the five things the generator gets wrong.
- [Capstone: ShopFlow — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/capstone-shopflow.md): Plan and build ShopFlow with ZudoJS: a runnable core for accounts, products and a checkout that never oversells, then milestones toward services.
- [Capstone: a production SaaS — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/capstone-saas.md): Build FeesDesk, a multi-school fees platform in naira: a tested payment slice that uses most of ZudoJS, then milestones and the graduation checklist.
- [Final production challenge — ZudoJS Academy](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/learn/final-challenge.md): Someone else's gift-card feature works in the demo and fails everything else. Find its problems, fix them step by step, and prove each fix with a test.

## Getting started

- [Getting Started](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/getting-started.md): Install ZudoJS on Node.js 24, run a first module by hand, then scaffold a working API with the zudo CLI. Prerequisites, quick start and troubleshooting.
- [Your First App](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/getting-started-first-app.md): Build your first ZudoJS API with the zudo CLI: create a project, call /api/v1/examples, generate a users resource and run its tests. Real output throughout.
- [Project Structure](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/getting-started-project-structure.md): What the zudo CLI writes for a ZudoJS project: folders, server.ts to repository request flow, .env config, integrations and the zudojs markers.

## Concepts

- [Core Concepts](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/concepts.md): Understand the fundamental building blocks of the Zudo framework — application architecture, configuration, contexts, dependency injection, lifecycle, and modules.
- [Configuration](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/concepts-configuration.md): Layered configuration system with sources, resolvers, and schema validation. Environment variables, files, memory, and remote config sources with priority ordering.
- [Contexts](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/concepts-contexts.md): Execution context propagation using AsyncLocalStorage for request-scoped data across async call chains in Zudo applications.
- [Lifecycle](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/concepts-lifecycle.md): State machine pattern for predictable component lifecycle management with dependency ordering, hooks, and graceful shutdown.
- [Modules](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/concepts-modules.md): Composable units of functionality with dependency management, registration, and lifecycle integration for Zudo applications.
- [Dependency Injection](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/concepts-dependency-injection.md): Dependency injection in ZudoJS: a token-based container with singleton, transient and scoped lifetimes and circular dependency detection.

## Architecture

- [Architecture](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/architecture.md): How Zudo's modular, layered architecture enables scalable TypeScript applications. DI container, lifecycle management, module system, and event-driven design.
- [Adapters](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/architecture-adapters.md): Platform-agnostic boundary layer between Zudo and external systems. Adapter pattern, registration, capabilities, transport abstractions, and custom adapter creation.
- [Runtime](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/architecture-runtime.md): The ZudoJS runtime orchestrates startup and shutdown: lifecycle state machine, dependency ordering, signal handling and graceful shutdown.
- [Dependency Direction](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/architecture-dependency-direction.md): Dependency rules that keep ZudoJS packages free of circular imports: the package graph, allowed and forbidden import patterns, and how they are enforced.
- [Module System](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/architecture-module-system.md): How ZudoJS modules work: defining composable, dependency-aware modules, registering them, lifecycle hooks, and best practices for structuring an app.

## Packages

- [Packages — @zudojs/*](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages.md): Browse all 39 @zudojs packages by category: foundation, runtime, application, transport, security and platform. Search by name and pick a version.
- [@zudojs/adapters — Boundary Layer Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-adapters.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/adapters — the boundary layer between Zudojs and external platforms.
- [@zudojs/api — Transport-agnostic API layer](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-api.md): @zudojs/api for ZudoJS: define an operation once and serve it over HTTP, RPC, queues and the CLI with shared validation and interceptors.
- [@zudojs/auth — JWT, Sessions, RBAC, Password Hashing](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-auth.md): @zudojs/auth reference: JWT access and refresh tokens, scrypt password hashing, sessions, RBAC and brute-force lockout for ZudoJS apps.
- [@zudojs/cache — Caching, Adapters & Invalidation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-cache.md): @zudojs/cache reference: CacheService, memory adapter, tag-based invalidation, distributed locking, metrics and middleware for ZudoJS apps.
- [zudojs-cli — Command-Line Interface Framework](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-cli.md): zudojs-cli 2.1 reference for ZudoJS: install as zudojs or zudo, create wired APIs, generate CRUD resources, add Prisma, Redis or Docker, exit codes.
- [@zudojs/config — Layered Configuration System](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-config.md): @zudojs/config reference: layered configuration with sources, stores, resolvers, schema validation and lifecycle management for ZudoJS apps.
- [@zudojs/constants — Shared Constants, Enums & Type-Safe Literals](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-constants.md): @zudojs/constants docs: branded ID types, HTTP constants, lifecycle states, validation patterns, cache strategies and serialization limits for ZudoJS.
- [@zudojs/container — Token-Based Dependency Injection Container](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-container.md): @zudojs/container docs: token-based dependency injection for TypeScript with scopes, lifecycle management, circular dependency detection and auto-disposal.
- [@zudojs/core — Application Lifecycle, Context & Runtime](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-core.md): @zudojs/core docs: application lifecycle, execution context propagation, modules, configuration, logging and runtime orchestration for ZudoJS apps.
- [@zudojs/cqrs — Command Query Responsibility Segregation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-cqrs.md): @zudojs/cqrs docs: CQRS for TypeScript. Command and query buses, typed handlers, middleware and event extensions for separating reads from writes in ZudoJS.
- [@zudojs/crypto — Cryptographic Primitives Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-crypto.md): @zudojs/crypto docs: hashing, encryption, password hashing, tokens, signatures, key derivation and secure random generation for ZudoJS apps.
- [@zudojs/database — Database Infrastructure Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-database.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/database — database clients, repositories, transactions, migrations, seeding, caching, and connection management.
- [@zudojs/docs — Documentation Infrastructure](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-docs.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/docs — structured document model, registry, validation, navigation, frontmatter parsing, and output generation.
- [@zudojs/errors — Shared Error Hierarchy Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-errors.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/errors — shared error base class, error codes, error categories, and error handling utilities for the ZudoLib framework.
- [@zudojs/events — Event Bus Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-events.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/events — the event bus, emitter, middleware, and registry for Zudojs.

- [@zudojs/lifecycle — Lifecycle Orchestration Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-lifecycle.md): @zudojs/lifecycle docs: state machine, component hooks, dependency ordering, graceful shutdown, signal handling and rollback for ZudoJS apps.
- [@zudojs/logger — Structured Logging Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-logger.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/logger — structured logging with transports, formatters, context propagation, and lifecycle management for the Zudojs framework.
- [@zudojs/messaging — Messaging Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-messaging.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/messaging — the in-process message bus infrastructure for Zudojs.

- [@zudojs/observability — Structured Logging, Metrics & Tracing](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-observability.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/observability — structured logging, metrics, distributed tracing, context propagation, and telemetry exporters.

- [@zudojs/scheduler — Time & Recurring Execution Engine](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-scheduler.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/scheduler — the time and recurring execution engine for the Zudojs framework.

- [@zudojs/security — Security Primitives Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-security.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/security — input validation, CORS, CSRF, rate limiting, security headers, and more.
- [@zudojs/serialization — Data Translation Layer](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-serialization.md): Complete documentation for @zudojs/serialization — JSON serialization with type preservation, transformer registry, envelopes, and encoding utilities.

- [@zudojs/transactions — Transaction Lifecycle Documentation](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/packages-transactions.md): @zudojs/transactions docs: transaction lifecycle, async context propagation, adapter abstraction, savepoints, hooks and rollback for ZudoJS.

## Optional

- [Changelog](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/changelog.md): What changed in each Zudo release: per-package release notes generated from the packages' own changelogs, newest first.
- [Contributing](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/contributing.md): Help build the Zudo framework. Guidelines for contributions, development setup, code style, testing, and PR review process.
- [Roadmap](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/roadmap.md): Where Zudo is headed. Features, milestones, and vision. Current releases, near-term, mid-term, and long-term goals.
- [Package Rules](https://zudojs.oyinlola.site/docs/rules.md): Conventions and constraints that all @zudojs packages must follow. File naming, folder organization, code style, imports, testing, and dependency direction.
